title: Asymptotic stability of Landau solutions to the MHD system and energy decay
summary: We consider the three-dimensional incompressible MHD system. Any weak solution satisfying a strong energy inequality is $L^2$-asymptotically stable around a Landau solution. Under an additional integrability assumption on the initial perturbation, we also obtain an explicit algebraic decay rate for the $L^2$-norm of the velocity and magnetic perturbations.
